findings.title: Failed 'Add entry' wipes the text the user typed
findings.where: Plant detail page /plants/:id, Journal > New entry (pages/plants/[id].vue addEntry)
findings.steps: Open /plants/2, make POST /api/journal fail (e.g. 500 text/plain or offline), type 'Aphids on lower leaves 🐛 — sprayed soap' in Entry, click Add entry.
findings.expected: Error shown and the typed text kept so the user can retry.
findings.actual: Error 'Could not add the entry.' is shown but the textarea is emptied. addEntry calls entryForm.reset() in the finally block, so it runs on failure as well as success.
findings.evidence: After the failed POST, the textarea value was '' and the alert said 'Could not add the entry.'

findings.title: Journal requests have no timeout: a hung save stays on 'Saving…' forever
findings.where: Plant detail journal form (POST /api/journal); also edit (PUT) and delete (DELETE) of entries
findings.steps: Open /plants/3, make POST /api/journal never respond, type text, click Add entry, wait more than 10 s.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s with a visible error, and the button becomes usable again.
findings.actual: After 12 s the button still reads 'Saving…' and is disabled. No timeout is set in useApiClient/useApiFetch, so the edit and delete buttons hang the same way.

findings.title: Journal load errors offer no Retry (plant detail and Journal page)
findings.steps: Make GET /api/journal?... return 503 with an HTML body. Go to a plant from the plants list, then click Journal in the nav.
findings.expected: Error state with a Retry button that reloads the data without a page reload.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load the journal.' is shown. There is no retry button (plant section buttons: only 'Add entry'; Journal page: none). refreshJournal exists but is only called after a mutation.

findings.title: Out-of-range ids crash journal endpoints with 500
findings.steps: curl -X PUT /api/journal/99999999999999999999 with a valid body; DELETE the same id; GET /api/journal?plant_id=99999999999999999999; POST with plant_id 99999999999999999999.
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error. SQLite overflows on ints above 2^63 because the int params have no upper bound.
findings.evidence: All four requests returned 'Internal Server Error 500'

findings.title: Search box sends a request per keystroke with no length limit; past 80 characters it shows a raw validation error
findings.steps: Type or paste more than 80 characters into Search.
findings.expected: Input limited to 80 characters, or a friendly message.
findings.actual: The server returns 422 'String should have at most 80 characters' and the page swaps the results for the error alert ('Q: String should...'). The input has no maxlength.
findings.evidence: GET /api/journal?q=<81 chars> returns 422 string_too_long; journal.vue input has no maxlength

findings.title: Add/delete are not idempotent: retrying after a lost response duplicates the entry
findings.steps: Click Add entry. The server saves the entry but the response is lost (network drop). The text is cleared anyway, but if the user retypes and resubmits, a second entry is created.
findings.expected: One entry, using an idempotency key or a duplicate check.
findings.actual: Nothing prevents a duplicate. Only the disabled button guards against double clicks.
findings.evidence: Code: addEntry posts with no idempotency key

findings.title: Character counter and maxlength count UTF-16 units, not characters
findings.steps: Type emoji such as 🌱 into the entry.
findings.expected: Up to 500 characters, as the server allows (the server limit counts code points).
findings.actual: Each emoji counts as 2, so the browser stops at about 250 emoji and the counter shows the wrong number left.
findings.evidence: Code: maxlength=500 and form.body.length versus server max_length=500 in code points
